chunks: 1253 - Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"Then when the salat is concluded, disperse through the land and seek from the bounty of Allah."
He said: "The salat is on the day of al-Jumuʿah, and the dispersal is on the day of Saturday."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the prayer, here referring to the Friday prayer
key_terms.الِانْتِشَارُ: dispersing in the land after prayer
key_terms.فَضْلِ اللَّهِ: the bounty and provision of Allah

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام interpret the verse "Then when the prayer is concluded, disperse through the land and seek from the bounty of Allah"?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to the salat of Friday, while the command to disperse in the land is understood as taking place on Saturday. It highlights a specific interpretive teaching from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the timing and practical application of the Quranic verse.
